notes.content:

In addition, we’ve added in a new boss to Snowmere (Draemar the Vile) and a fast travel portal from Jormungahr to Snowmere that makes it easier for players to bring their friends into the final fight against the Dragon Kur. 

Before starting your adventures, we kindly ask that you click the link below to read the latest patch notes for important information/instructions/changes to help ensure you have best possible experience: 

Current Updates - https://steamcommunity.com/app/307880/discussions/1/3730700942543869447/

Archived  Updates - https://steamcommunity.com/app/307880/discussions/1/1640915206442322063/

Thanks to our awesome community for all the support and continually providing feedback to help make the game better for all players. ːsteamhappyː

Stay Savage! 

-Euryidium

notes.title: GAME UPDATE (BUILD 140) LIVE!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7623929/b78742c0e72299a599c35bf078d0209c8c10a313.jpg[/img]

Savages!

A new Game Update (Build 140) is now available for download. In this build players will find an array of bug fixes and tweaks to various items/weapons/armor/creatures/ingame locations. In addition, based on feedback we have received from the community, we have revamped the spawning system for most bosses in the game. Players will now find these spawners to be more reliable and less random. Also, we have gone through and re-organized the journal for better readability and overhauled up much of the lore on Snowmere and Freydalyn to be less cryptic and a bit more direct. 

Lastly, we’d like to honor three players: [b]quentin, Jebe, and free-eagle[/b] for the 500+  hours spent playing Savage Lands and feedback contributed. For this great feat, these heroes have been immortalized ingame. Visit the “Heroes of Tarvhas” monument near the giant Wyrm Tower on Snowmere to unlock the journal entry. 

Before starting your adventures, we kindly ask that you click the link below to read the latest patch notes for important information/instructions/changes to help ensure you have best possible experience:

Link - https://steamcommunity.com/app/307880/discussions/1/1640915206442322063/

As always, a big [b]“THANKS”[/b] to our dedicated community of players that continually share feedback to improve the game. Your support means the world to Last Bastion Studios.

Stay Savage!

-Euryidium

notes.title: New Steam Trading Cards and Game Update Live!
notes.content:
[b][h3]Greetings Savages![/h3][/b]For over a month our forges here at Last Bastion Studios have been focused on hammering out new stuff for the game. With this release Savage Landers now have access to Steam Trading Cards, updated content, bug fixes and balance tweaks. This release is one of many in our continued efforts to provide players with a more rich and fun survival experience. More info below!

[h3]Steam Trading Cards[/h3]Long overdue, but well worth the wait. Players and fans will find this Savage Trading Card bundle complete with badges, emoticons, and profile backgrounds that capture the spirit of the game!

How do you get them? Random card drops occur over time while playing Savage Lands and if you are super lucky, card drops will be of the special foil variety. Foil cards are quite rare and very valuable to collectors and fans alike.

Be sure to check out the Steam Trading Marketplace to see what sort of other unique inventory items members of the Steam Community might offer for any of the trading cards.

[b]Trading Cards Series 1 Contains:[/b]
[b][list][*]8 trading cards
[*]5 regular badges + 1 foil badge
[*]3 profile backgrounds
[*]10 emoticons[/list][/b]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/7623929/8ddef41f826c144e28bed2ca19bd4ab07c6db3cd.png[/img]
[h3]Fabled Weapons[/h3]Fabled weapons and armor have made their way to the Sundered Isles of Tarvhas. These ancient relics are from a time long since passed. They were inspired by the originals found in the legacy version of the game. We have rebalanced them and added new visual FX to capture their uniqueness.

It is rumored that the dungeons of [b]Meltok[/b] and [b]Carta Sul[/b] hold the secrets to unlocking these powerful weapons of war.

[h3]Bug Fixes and Balance[/h3]Various items, creatures, armor have gone through additional balance changes for playability. This process is ongoing, so please let us know what you think!

We’d like to thank our dedicated community of players for providing a continuous stream of feedback to help shape Savage Lands into the game that it is today. 

For a full list of tweaks/changes please follow the link below. Returning players there are some important details in the patch notes we recommend you read before launching into your world.

[b]PATCH NOTES: [/b]https://steamcommunity.com/app/307880/discussions/1/1640915206442322063/

Be well and Stay Savage! ːSummoningStoneː

-Euryidium

notes.title: Game Update 32 Now Available + Patch Notes
notes.content:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/7623929/7a77fba4ceba2e3bbf83facf6292bcbf0e7c9b5d.jpg[/img][b]Greetings Savage Landers![/b]

Last Bastion Studios is pleased to announce the release of our latest Game Update (Build 30). Over the last month we've spent a lot of time rebalancing the later areas of the game to create a much more rich and unique experience. This work will tie into additional content plans we have for the future, so it was imperative we got these foundational changes out of the way.

There is still much work to do, but thanks to our dedicated community of players we have managed to reshape/balance/tune the game at an accelerated pace.

We look forward to building a better game for all players!

As always, Stay Savage!

-Last Bastion Studios

[h1]IMPORTANT: World Update[/h1]
Due to the vast number of changes to the terrain and objects across all the islands done in [b]Build 24[/b], we are recommending existing players returning to the game from prior releases create new worlds. Because of all these changes, we cannot guarantee the integrity of your world saves prior to this update. Existing characters are fine to use.

If you are new to the game, this does not apply.

[h1]IMPORTANT: Video Settings Update[/h1]
[b]FOR THIS BUILD[/b] we do recommend [b]EXISTING[/b] players take the following steps to refresh their video settings:
[b][list][*]Go into Options
[*]Click Settings
[*]Click Default
[*]Click Apply[/list][/b]

Once this is done please adjust the options as you see fit. This will clean out any residual data from previous builds. We do apologize for the inconvenience.

[h1] Build 30 Changes [/h1]
Improvements and changes that you can expect to see in this build:

[list][*]Major Bug Fix: Resolved rare crash with skeleton spawn in Carta Sul
[*]Major Bug Fix: Addressed several areas in the world where the player could get stuck
[*]Bug Fix: Copper Armor now displays correct material
[*]Bug Fix: Devourer Armor now displays white fur on player when worn
[*]Bug Fix: Iron Nodes now use correct texture
[*]Bug Fix: Improved performance around portals
[*]Content: Heart of Tarvhas now required to summon Kur
[*]Content: Additional Spirit creatures added to the world (Furies, Tortured skeletons)
[*]Balance: All spirit based creatures now deal Spirit attack damage which bypasses damage mitigation stats on armor
[*]Content: Lycor now roams the Ruins of Ketta Zah on Jormughr
[*]Content: Kiffi changed to spirit and now roams Carta Sul
[*]Content: Elite Furies added to the Ruins of Ketta Zah on Jormughr
[*]Content: Spirit Armor line added to the game, mitigates damage from Spirit based creatures
[*]Content: Labels have been added to various items for better sorting in the crafting UI
[*]Content: Crystalline Armor renamed to Crystalline Spirit Armor; requirements to craft have changed
[*]Content: Hal Potion descriptions updated
[*]Balance: Kur health reduced by 10%
[*]Balance: Kur tail whip now has a chance to disease
[*]Balance:  Forest Giants have been revamped and rebalanced
[*]Balance: Creatures now have a chance to drop no loot
[*]Balance: Kiilot no longer spawn on Freydalyn
[*]Balance: Kiilot health increased by 50%
[*]Balance: Iron Armor and weapons removed from Crafting list
[*]Balance: Iron Armor now drop only from creatures
[*]Balance: Steel Ingots now require Iron ore instead of Iron Ingots to craft
[*]Balance: Tin through Steel armor/weapons repair requirements have changed; now requires Basic Forge
[*]Balance: Steel Armor requirements have changed
[*]Balance: Copper through Silver armor balance has changed
[*]Balance: Hardened Leather Armor is no longer craftable; drop only now
[*]Balance: Savage Fur Armor damage mitigation increased by 15%
[*]Balance: Savage Fur Armor heat mitigation increased by 50%
[*]Balance: Savage Fur Armor crafting requirements updated
[*]Balance: Devourer Armor crafting requirements updated
[*]Balance: Devourer Armor heat mitigation increased by 50%
[*]Balance: Dragon Forge now requires Everwood to construct
[*]Balance: Silver has been removed from Freydalyn
[*]Balance: Mithras no longer required to craft Silver armor
[*]Balance: Mithras now protects against Spirit damage and disease
[*]Balance: Mithras cold mitigation increased by 48%
[*]Balance: Crafting reqs for Enchanted Chest have changed
[*]Balance: Wolfsbane requirements and stats updated to fit new crafting progression
[*]Balance: Golden Reaver rebalanced
[*]Balance: Silver and Gold weapons rebalanced
[*]Balance: Additional Iron, Silver and Gold nodes have been added to the game.
[*]Balance: Shields durability, crafting requirements, damage mitigation normalized with current armor progression
[*]Balance: Silver Nodes have been removed from Freydalyn
[*]Balance: Potions are now produced in quantities of 3
[*]Balance: 3 Wood Planks now only require 1 log
[*]Balance: Frost Fern Bandages now require crafting table to craft[/list]

[h1]Known Issues[/h1]
[list][*]Some creatures such as Ghuuls, Goats, and large Wolves may continue to exhibit rubber banding issues during high latency online games; though reduced from previous builds.
[*]Plagued by Wolves achievement not completing for some characters created before Build 9.
[*]When a Summoning Orb is activated, players will need to scroll up in the UI to see the list of players in the game session
[*](Linux) Settings menu does not appear ingame. Video settings tweaks must be changed from the main menu.[/list]

Bugs can be reported here: [url= https://steamcommunity.com/app/307880/discussions/3/]Bug Forum[/url]
Suggestions and Feedback can be reported here: [url= https://steamcommunity.com/app/307880/discussions/7] Suggestions & Feedback Forum [/url]

notes.content:
Greetings Savages!

The Last Bastion team found a couple of last minute issues we wanted to quickly address. We do apologize the the back to back updates. Below is a list of improvements and changes that you can expect to see in our latest Game Update now available for download:

[h1]IMPORTANT: Video Settings Update[/h1]
[b]FOR THIS BUILD[/b] we do recommend [b]EXISTING[/b] players take the following steps to refresh their video settings:
[list][*]Go into Options

[h1]IMPORTANT: World Update[/h1]
Due to the vast number of changes to the terrain and objects across all the islands done in Build 9, we are recommending existing players returning to the game from prior releases create new worlds. Because of all these changes, we cannot guarantee the integrity of your world saves prior to this update. Existing characters are fine to use.

notes.title: New Savage Lands Game Update (Build 9) Live!
notes.content:
Hello Savages!

Last Bastion Studios is pleased to announce the release of our latest Game Update (Build 9) to the public. The LBS team has spent 3 months working on tons of fixes, tweaks, and balance changes to make a better game for you the players. Much of the work that went into this update was at the request of the community along with things we felt would help make a better game. The LBS team also tuned up the art giving the Savage Lands a much ominous look and feel. There is still more work to do and we look forward to your feedback.

Below is a high level overview of what to expect. For more detailed information and a [b]full list[/b] of changes please visit our [url= https://steamcommunity.com/app/307880/discussions/1/1727575977575465237/]forums[/url].

[h1]Art Changes[/h1]
[b]New Colors, the Rebirth of the Savage Lands:[/b] Over the last several months Last Bastion spent a lot of time reviewing the old art style found in 422. Our conclusion was that the current implementation with its smoggy atmosphere, dirty/muddy snow, and color palette simply did not sell a world that was frozen by bitter cold and battle worn by war. So we did a lot of research. We studied the landscapes, skies, snow and fauna of real world locations and then applied those color palettes to the game. With our most recent update, we've re-envisioned colors, lightning and general atmosphere to give the game a fresh new look and tell a stronger visual narrative about the soul of Savage Lands.

[h1]AI Updates[/h1]
Work has continued across the AI systems. Creature attack ranges have been further adjusted to reduce damage from long distances, pathing around objects have been tuned, and spawners rebalanced. 

[h1]Player Progression and Item Balance[/h1]
This update will change the crafting experience. Some items and armor have gone through balance changes to better fit the progression we envision for the game. This is an ongoing process and will take multiple updates before it is complete

Thanks again for all the support!

Stay Savage!
Last Bastion Studios

notes.title: Build 421 Released as default! Patch Notes for 2/17
notes.content:
Here is a list of improvements and changes that you can expect with this update 421:

[h1]Performance improvements [/h1]
From the second you launch into a new world, you will notice the improved load times. As you navigate the iced lands before you, the experience is drastically improved with this update!

[h1]Pathing and avoidance around structures, objects and other creatures much improved [/h1]
What this means is the AI will be functioning properly again. They will not be attacking you through walls, taking backpack rides on each other or standing around while you beat them in the face. Navigation should be drastically improved.

[h1]Animations improved [/h1]
You will notice changes in the movement and general feel of the enemies. Seek out different foes to see these updates first hand!

[h1]Increased combat performance and overall AI improvements [/h1]
Fights will feel better and balance numbers have been updated. You will no longer be attacked inside of buildings through the walls or see snow leak in through the ceiling of the house that you built so well.

[h1] Spawned items, enemies, and environment pieces have been tuned for each island [/h1]
This update will change the experience. You will find a different verity of enemies spawning in areas and rare spawns will be found more consistently. Item placement, dungeons, and buildings have been adjusted as well. Adventure forth!

[h1]Kur, hidden weapons, and other changes [/h1]
All I can say is that Kur will make sure that these lands stay Savage. Hidden weapons and a few other surprises need to be discovered by braves Savages. 

[h1]If you like more specific patch notes from 420 to 421, here you all go: [/h1]
Balance: Dragon - Reduced damage (more in line with current armor scaling)
Balance: Dragon - Increased time from 20 secs to 40s from when Kur will fly away if not attacked during battle.
Balance: Forest Giants - Health increased by 20% and walk speed slowed by 10%
Balance: Forest Giants - Alert status time reduced by 10 seconds (will not chase the player as long)
Balance: Forest Giants - General attack damage reduced by 50% (more in line with current armor scaling)
Balance: Forest Giants - Initial ground pound 20% stronger than 378
Balance: Forest Giants - Increased Everwood drop rate by 25%
Balance: Whetstones can now be crafted by player
Balance: Helion and Lycor health rebalanced
Balance: Helion and Lycor damage reduced to fit current armor scaling
Balance: Grey Reaver and Golden Reaver damage reduced to better
Balance: Grey Reaver and Golden Reaver repair costs updated
Balance: Shadow Shroud; Drakonous Shards needed reduced from 150 to 120
Balance: Drakonous shards have a chance of dropping from more mid/high tier boss mobs
Balance: Reduced chance of getting diseased by Grinfels/Killots/Plague Wolves/Ghuuls by 22%
Balance: Spirit Wolves added to more population spawners across the world
Balance: Chilkoot/Rycnth/Kiffi (blue Fury)/Kruul spawn frequency reduced
Balance: Chilkoot spawn has been moved and to a single area
Balance: Flesh Ripper is no longer dual wield (in preparation for longer term changes)
Balance: Reduced Infernal Ghuuls AoE fire damage by 50%
Balance: Player stamina usage while sprinting reduced by 10% (player uses less stamina)
Balance: Tweaked attack ranges and cooldowns across Undead Fury (includes bosses) class of creatures
Balance: Tuned drops for young wolves and deer found on Snowmere to better reflect size of kill
Balance: Tuned wolf population on Snowmere to better reflect desired difficulty of area
Balance: Shadow Shroud attack speed increased from .4 seconds to .8 seconds. Could change based on future balance and new legacy/high tier weapons introduced into the game.
Balance: Wolfsbane attack speed increased from .5 seconds to .85 seconds. Could change based on future balance and new legacy/high tier weapons introduced into the game.
Bug: Fixed collider preventing players from entering DerStata
Bug: Fixed issue with certain creatures and named bosses not being counted towards task list and achievements
Bug: Fixed collider issue on bush causing chopping issues
Bug: Killot AoE disease removed, now disease is applied on attack
Bug: Fixed issue with Ram/Goat loot table
Bug: Fixed lore text detailing where Forest Giant Eldar can be found
Bug: Fixed camp fire flicker that would distort terrain at specific viewing angles at night

Thank you once again for all the feedback and posts in these forums over 2017. We look forward to your feedback on this update and hope you enjoy these Savage Lands.

Stay Savage,
Logan

notes.content:

notes.title: Upcoming update, big island beta closing, and a general update.
notes.content:
Hello Savages!

We are currently working on an update for game right now that will contain the updates/fixes for the following major game features:

[h1]Pathing and avoidance around structures, objects and other creatures much improved[/h1]

What this means is the AI will be functioning properly again. They will not be attacking you through walls, taking backpack rides on each other or standing around while you beat them in the face.

[h1]Animations improved[/h1]

[h1]Increased combat performance[/h1]

[h1]Spawners better tuned for each island[/h1]

From the numbers of enemies to how often you see them, this update will change the experience.

[h1]Kur[/h1]

All I can say is that Kur will make sure that these lands stay Savage. Need something on this list to remain secret, right?

Now, what does this mean for the big island branch? It is closing for right now because we want to make sure that the base game (the one we shfited to almost year agos with the Unity 5 engine update) is a good solid baseline for you as players and as customers.

This update is currently pencil'd in to be live before Christmas break so you all can enjoy Savage Lands again over your vacations. I will also plan a live stream mid December so we all checkin on the update together and get Zak to draw us something new!

Until then, enjoy your Thanksgiving coming up and stay Savage!
-Logan

notes.title: Game Update #44, Build 0.8.3.353 is live!
notes.content:
[h1][b] WARNING [/b][/h1]
The original Sundered Isle's content, which utilized Unity 4, has been [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/307880/discussions/1/412449508295199149/]moved to a Legacy Branch[/url] allowing players to access their old save data and continue playing the old content as they wish. Transferring save data between the Main game branch and the Legacy game branch is not supported.

[h1] Big Changes: [/h1]
AI Updates, Crash Fixes, and a way to get Unstuck! 

[h1]New Features & Patch Notes: [/h1]
[b]AI Updates [/b] have hit the islands. While there are still changes to come to spawners, pathing, and AI, these updates should allow to continue to happily slaughter the creatures that scamper about the lands. If you see something that doesn’t look right, please give us some feedback!

[b] Crash Fixes [/b] have been and will continue to be a priority with every update. Keep posting in the forums when you have a crash. It always helps if you have a good solid way to reproduce it! 

[b] A Way To Get Unstuck! [/b] While we are updating the art, the world, and currently the new big island – you now have a way to escape from being stuck!
In the chat/text enter box, just type this: /stuck
This command will warp you back to respawn point and kill you. Now to answer the question that will be most asked: Why kill us? Why would you do such a Savage thing for bugs in YOUR game?
Here is your answer: We kill players that use /stuck to get it balanced for early access. Once we are further along and have the map put together better, this feature will see an update, maybe even a button and a cooldown timer. We want players to be able to use it when in distress and not as a way to exploit the game.

Environment:
[list][*]New art added to Snowmere, Freydalyn, and Jormungahr. 
[*]All the shorelines of the islands are continuing to be updated. [/list]

[h1] Bug Fixes: [/h1]
[list][*]AI and creature spawning.
[*]Performance updates.
[*]Various crash fixes.[/list]

[h1] Known Issues [/h1]
[list][*]Creatures hoping over things and ‘backpacking’.  [/list]

[h1] Next Up: [/h1]
[list] [*]More Performance Updates.
[*]More creature AI, and pathing updates.
 [*]Item adding and balancing continues.
[*]More art and design updates to the world.
[*]Bug fixes. [/list]

Thanks again for your patience while waiting for this update. The biggest island yet is coming and it is taking a ton of focus for us to get it right. Hang in there Savages!

Best,
Logan

These flaming weapons will help to add more damage to the gold weapon you selected for the enchantment, and keep you a bit warmer in these icy lands!
[b] More Lore [/b]has been added to the game! 10 new pieces has been placed through the islands to give players more answers and perhaps also asking more questions.
[b] Kur Leaves The New Savages Alone! [/b] The starting area will now allow players to be safe from his direct attacks. If you venture too far on the starting island, he will still be on the hunt. [*]New art updates for multiple buildings. [/list]

[h1] Bug Fixes: [/h1]
[list][*]Kur will no longer attack the starting area.
[*]Several pathing issues and environment holes have been fixed.
[*]Various crash fixes. [/list]

[h1] Known Issues [/h1]
[list][*]Kur not pathing properly between the islands that the player is not currently on.
[*]Enemies popping and not pathing correctly.  [/list]

[h1] Next Up: [/h1]
[list][*]More updates to Kur.
[*]Item adding and balancing continues.
[*]More art and design updates to the new world.
[*]Bug fixes. [/list]

Should you wander too close to one of his perches or get caught in the open when he flies overhead, beware! Should he see you, Kur will now rain down fire from above until you find cover, die, or he loses interest…Whichever may happen first. Savages best served well-done!
[b] More Lore [/b]has been added to the game! Ten new pieces of lore have been added throughout the islands providing more answers (and, perhaps, even more questions) about this forsaken realm.
[b]Performance Updates [/b]are now live in the default build. We will continue to make adjustments every build to improve the experience for everybody.

New items added! Here is a list of all of the new items that have been added or adjusted:
[list] [*]The Soul of Kruul has been swapped out with the Rune of Command which will now be used to open the portal to Snowmere.
[*]Flint Axes have been removed from the game. The lowest Axe tier is now stone. [/list]

Art:
[list][*]New icons and art added to the Journal. 
[*] New animations have been added for Spirit Orbs and Spirit Shards use.
[*]New art updates for multiple buildings. [/list]

Environment:
[list][*]New art added to Freydalyn, and Jormungahr. [/list]

[h1] Bug Fixes: [/h1]
[list][*]Spirit Shards are now properly consumed on use.
[*]Holding a Spirit Orb will no longer keep you from freezing.
[*]Spears now do damage on every attack.
[*]Torches no longer have a global sound when they break/extinguish.
[*]The secondary attack from a Killot will no longer instantly kill players.
[*]The torches in Carta Sul have been adjusted to display correctly.
[*]Various crash fixes. [/list]

[h1] Known Issues [/h1]
[list][*]LOD issues with certain objects.
[*]Enemies popping and not pathing correctly.  [/list]

[h1] Next Up: [/h1]
[list] [*]More Performance Updates.
[*]Item adding and balancing continues.
[*]More art and design updates to the new world.
[*]Bug fixes. [/list]

notes.title: Game Update #39, Build 0.8.3.265, is now live!
notes.content:
[h1][b] WARNING [/b][/h1]
The original Sundered Isle's content, which utilized Unity 4, has been [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/307880/discussions/1/412449508295199149/]moved to a Legacy Branch[/url] allowing players to access their old save data and continue playing the old content as they wish. Transferring save data between the Main game branch and the Legacy game branch is not supported.

[h1] Big Changes: [/h1]
Spears, The First Dungeon: Carta Sul, and More Lore!

[h1]New Features & Patch Notes: [/h1] 
[b] Spears! [/b] This new two-handed weapon type has been added and is now ready to be crafted! There is also a unique spear named ‘The Needle’ hiding somewhere in the world…
[b]The First Dungeon: Carta Sul [/b] is ready to be explored by Savage that are not scared of what they might find in the dark underground of the world. 
[b]15 New Pieces of Lore! [/b] 14 of them are scattered about Freydalyn while the last one is located on Jormungahr.

New enemy variants have been added to the game:
[list][*]Blighted E’ks have been added to Shudderwood, Freydalyn.
[*]Glacial E’ks have been added to Northwind, Freydalyn.
[*]Goats have returned to the game and can be found in mountainous terrain in Freydalyn. 
[*]A new unique skeleton, Yignol, can be found in the Ruins of Carta Sul.
[*]A stronger, spear using variant of the Decayed Skeleton has been added to earlier parts of Freydalyn.
[*]Stronger than average, spear wielding standard E’ks can be found in the forest of Eldar. [/list]

New items added! Here is a list of all of the new items that have been added or adjusted:
[list] [*] ‘Eriandhor’s Cleaver’ is a new unqiue two handed axe that drops from Eriandhor.
[*]A returning weapon from the legacy server called the “Flesh Ripper” is now hidden somewhere in the world…
[*]The unique shield, ‘The Shield of Unity’ is a chance drop from Yignol.
[*]Forest Giants no longer drops their Souls and the Crystal Skulls gained from them are no longer obtainable. Instead, each Forest Giant guarantees drops a unique Rune.
[*]The portal from Freydalyn to Jormungahr now requires the 4 unique Forest Giant Runes instead of the 4 unique Crystal Skulls. All Players who had certain Crystal Skulls previously should find them converted to an equivalent Rune.
[*]The Legendary sword, Shadowshroud, no longer drops off of Drackonus. Instead, he drops Shadowshroud’s Hilt 100% of the time, which allows dedicated Players to craft Shadowshroud via a Dragonforge and 250 Shards of Drackonus. 
[*]Shards of Drackonus now have a 10% chance of dropping off of any standard creature in Jormungahr. [/list]

Art:
[list][*]New icons and art added to the Journal. 
[*]New art added for Lore items.
[*]New art updates for multiple buildings.
[*]The art for Portals have been updated to be one-sided.  
[*]Fog is now closer to the player and also increased to change the atmosphere. [/list]

Environment:
[list][*]Enemy spawners have been have been adjusted for a new difficulty flow on the islands of Freydalyn, and Jormungahr. 
[*]Build collision was added to all of the trees to prevent building on trees.
[*]Certain ambient props located throughout the world that weren’t destroyable / burnable previously now are. This includes burnable hay stacks.

[*]New doors were added to all of the houses for better visual and to fix holes on the top and bottom of the previous versions.
[*]Build Collision added to all of the houses, crafting stations and anything else you can build in the game. [/list]

[h1] Bug Fixes: [/h1]
[list][*]Fixed crashes for any older items that were removed by Design and were still present in players save files.
[*]Fixed build cursors always being red.
[*]Fixed the chat window disappearing issue.
[*]Various crash fixes. [/list]

[h1] Known Issues [/h1]
[list][*]LOD issues with certain objects.
[*]Enemies popping and not pathing correctly.  [/list]

[h1] Next Up: [/h1]
[list] [*]More Performance Updates.
[*]Item adding and balancing continues.
[*]More art and design updates to the new world.
[*]Bug fixes. [/list]

notes.title: Game Update #38, Build 0.8.3.231, is now live!
notes.content:
[h1][b] WARNING [/b][/h1]
The original Sundered Isle's content, which utilized Unity 4, has been [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/307880/discussions/1/412449508295199149/]moved to a Legacy Branch[/url] allowing players to access their old save data and continue playing the old content as they wish. Transferring save data between the Main game branch and the Legacy game branch is not supported.

[h1] Big Changes: [/h1]
Buildings Overhaul, New Traps, More Lore, and More Performance Updates!

[h1]New Features & Patch Notes: [/h1]
[b] Buildings Have Been Overhauled! [/b] Here is a rundown of everything that is changing for them in this update:
[list][*] There are 8 new buildings that can be crafted by the player. They are the Stone Shed, Stone Hut, Stone Bunker, Keep, Barracks, Stone Cabin, Gathering Hall, and Stone Lodge.
[*] All wooden buildings are now burnable. Be careful not to get caught inside once things heat up, or you may be in for a world of hurt! 
[*] All damaged buildings that pre-existed on the islands and were not player built are not repairable or destroyable. 
[*] Due to the overhaul of our building system, some players may encounter issues with pre-update saves and new buildings overlapping older, player-built structures. This issue can be fixed by simply destroying the overlapping offenders. The good news is that you will get some extra resources for your efforts!
[*]There are specific resistances for the buildings depending on what they are made out of. Wood buildings now are meant to be chopped down with axes and stone buildings demolished with hammers.
[*] All of the buildings have had a design pass on their health!
[*] All buildings have more refined damage states! [/list]

[b] More Lore [/b]has been added to the game! Now providing twice as much history to the island and its inhabitants! Players can now find various personal and historical accounts that may aid in their quest for survival. These entries may also provide some insight into events that led to the islands’ downfall and change, as well as clues how past exiles may have originally ended up there.

[b]Two New Traps [/b]have been added to the game! These traps are the Tension Coil Skewer Trap and the Spiked Spring Trap! Both offer new ways to protect buildings that you have crafted while you are off adventuring! They may hurt a bit in PvP too!

[b]Performance Updates [/b]are now live in the default build. We will continue to make adjustments every build to improve the experience for everybody.

New items added! Here is a list of all of the new items that have been added or adjusted:
[list] [*]Tension Coil Skewer Trap – A trip wire that will unleash wooden spears in a single thrust from a tightly wound rope.
[*]Spiked Spring Trap – Disease covered spikes that will penetrate the victim’s feet when stepped upon.
[*]More User Feedback for Burning! We’ve added an action meter to let you know if you are actively trying to set something on fire and how long it will take until it burns. [/list]

Art:
[list][*]New icons and art added to the Journal. 
[*] New art added for Lore items.
[*]New art updates for multiple buildings. [/list]

Environment:
[list][*]New art added to Freydalyn, and Jormungahr. [/list]

[h1] Bug Fixes: [/h1]
[list][*]Collected lore now displays correctly.
[*]A save/load trap bug has been addressed with losing the traps or crashing.
[*]Removed the Water Quality setting and set it to high by default. You now have a water on/off option.
[*]Unselected monikers are now more transparent for better differentiation.
[*]All health bars now fade out instead of popping.
[*]A fire screaming audio bug has been addressed.
[*]The moon is now opposite of the Sun’s position in the sky making it easier to track time at night.
[*]Various crash fixes. [/list]

[h1] Known Issues [/h1]
[list][*]LOD issues with certain objects.
[*]Enemies popping and not pathing correctly.  [/list]

[h1] Next Up: [/h1]
[list] [*]More Performance Updates.
[*]Item adding and balancing continues.
[*]More art and design updates to the new world.
[*]Bug fixes. [/list]

notes.title: Game Update #37, Build 0.8.3.200, is live!
notes.content:
[h1][b] WARNING [/b][/h1]
The original Sundered Isle's content, which utilized Unity 4, has been [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/307880/discussions/1/412449508295199149/]moved to a Legacy Branch[/url] allowing players to access their old save data and continue playing the old content as they wish. Transferring save data between the Main game branch and the Legacy game branch is not supported.

[h1] Big Changes: [/h1]

Lore, PVP Traps, and Performance Updates!

[h1]New Features & Patch Notes: [/h1]

[b] Lore [/b]has been added to the game! Lore will provide some insight into the history of the islands and its inhabitants as well helpful tips and clues that can be used to increase one’s chance of survival.

[b]Traps [/b]have been added to the game! Primitive traps can now be set by Players as an alternative way to deal damage to unsuspecting creatures and hostile players. PvE servers, use them to affect hostile enemy creatures. On PvP servers, in addition to creatures, they will also affect other Players as well. Be very careful while setting traps on PvP servers and mind where they lay, as you will be able to trigger your own traps and potentially damage yourself!

[b]Performance Updates [/b] are now live in the default build! We completed a healthy pass on optimization this build and you should definitely find some noticeable improvement to frame rate as well as a big reduction in hitching and stuttering that many had encountered while playing. For this update we worked hard to reduce our long load times, made many improvements to the Save/Load system to speed things up and reduce in-game hitching, added adjustable settings for Water Reflections in the Options Menu to help further speed things up, and made many more general performance improvements overall. Things are definitely feeling and running a lot better now!

New items added! Here is a list of all of the new items that have been added or adjusted:
[list] [*] All food items have been adjusted again to fill the players hunger meter up quicker.
[*] Bandages have been updated to be aligned in balance with the potions. [/list]

Art:
[list][*]New icons and art added to the Journal. 
[*] New art added for Lore items.
[*]New art makeover for the Journal. [/list]

Environment:
[list][*]New art added to Freydalyn, and Jormungahr. [/list]

[h1] Bug Fixes: [/h1]
[list][*]Replaced the way the game was handling update stats for performance improvements.
[*]Sped up internal network messaging system and fixed any subtle pre-existing errors.
[*]Now pre-loading more prefabs into pools (such as enemies), removing in-game hitching when loading enemies.
[*]Physics updates where implemented for performance improvements.
[*]Fixed trap save data issues.
[*]Resource nodes now take a number of hits rather than a HP value that's reduced.
[*]Rabbit trap now starts without a rabbit.
[*]Reduced network save file size, improving load times. [/list]

[h1] Known Issues [/h1]
[list][*]LOD issues with certain objects.
[*]Enemies popping and not pathing correctly.  [/list]

[h1] Next Up: [/h1]
[list] [*]More Performance Updates.
[*]More Lore.
[*]Burnable structures.
[*]Item adding and balancing continues.
[*]More art and design updates to the new world.
[*]Bug fixes. [/list]

[h1] Big Changes: [/h1]
Traps, Player Buildable Walls, Collision Update, New Potions, and Earth Golems!

[h1]New Features & Patch Notes: [/h1]
[b]Traps [/b]have finally made their way to the islands Tarvhas. The first one available to be made is a simple rabbit snare.

[b]Player Buildable Walls [/b] are available to construct and offer your shelters more protection! They come in three different varieties: Stick, Wood, and Stone.

[b]A Collision Update [/b] has been implemented and is ready for feedback. You should see less enemies getting stuck, running into the sea or generally acting funky. Praise be to the invisible blocking gods!

[b]New Potions [/b] are ready to be brewed! There are now 3 healing and 2 experimental potions that can offer you assistances in a time of need. 

[b]Earth Golems [/b] are now spawning on Freydalyn in the low muddy areas. These very quick and deadly elementals will provide a new challenge for those that seek them out.

New items added! Here is a list of all of the new items that have been added or adjusted:
[list] [*] All food items fill the players hunger meter up quicker.

notes.title: Game Update #34, Build 0.8.3.153, is live!
notes.content:
[h1][b] WARNING [/b][/h1]
The original Sundered Isle's content, which utilized Unity 4, has been [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/307880/discussions/1/412449508295199149/]moved to a Legacy Branch[/url] allowing players to access their old save data and continue playing the old content as they wish. Transferring save data between the Main game branch and the Legacy game branch is not supported.

Remember to check the Known Issues section below, as well as the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/307880/discussions/1/412449508295199149/]Bug Reports[/url] forum.


[h1] Big Changes: [/h1]
Enemy Health Bars, Status Effects, and Lord Drackonus.

[h1]New Features & Patch Notes: [/h1]
[b]Enemy Health Bars [/b] can now be toggled “On” in your options. This will give you the information to know if you are equipped with a weapon strong enough for the fights you are trying to pick.
[b]Status Effects [/b] have been reworked and updated with new ways to remove these disabilities.
[b]Lord Drackonus [/b] is a mysterious and worthy foe that is waiting at night for you to step onto the island of Jormungahr. Are you brave enough to face him?

New items added! Here is a list of all of the new items that have been added or adjusted:
[list] [*]Flawless Items have been removed from the game entirely.
[*] Babo Shrooms can now be found on all of the islands, eating them causes disease, grinding some up makes babo powder which cures disease, or you can soak less of them in a alchemy cauldron to make a babo potion which also cures disease. 
[*]Nightbloom flowers have returned.  There is only 100 of them on the island, each character can only get them once.  5 Nightbloom flowers makes one potion of Kurere, which is the ultimate instant heal. [*]Healing from non bandage sources now takes WAY longer than before, instead of 7 second heals it 
now takes 30 seconds to get the same healing effect. 
[*]Items that cure disease, bleeding, or poison now ALWAYS cure those effects, and do so instantly.
[*]Poison is now low damage with a really long time frame.
[*]Bleed is now high damage with a short time frame.
[*]Disease is completely different now, while diseased you cannot regenerate stamina, and any stamina consuming actions you perform costs double stamina.
[*]Cotton, Babo Shrooms now respawn after 1 game-days worth of time.
[*]All ore nodes respawn after 1/2 game-days worth of time.
[*]Forward movement speed for walking and running has increased.
[*]Day and Night have been updated to make Day time longer than night time. [/list]

Art:
[list][*]New art for the islands of Freydalyn and Jormunghar.
[*]Effects have been added to the volcanic vents of Jormunghar.
[*]The Trogre has had model and texture adjustments.
[*]New icons and art added to the Journal. [/list]

Environment:
[list][*]The Ice Shelf is now much colder.
[*]New locations added to Freydalyn, and Jormungahr.
[*]The Inferno stone has been adjusted to be easier to mine. 
[*]Hidden Cove has been updated.
[*]The Monolith now is properly textured. [/list]

Enemies:
[list] [*]Dragon Slayer Drackonus and has a chance to be found on Jormungahr. He has excellent armor, and an exclusive weapon the "Shadow Shroud".
[*]Leashing time has been adjusted, and the healing effect has been temporarily removed until we can get it working better.
[*]Eirandor and Kiffi the Deforesters can be found in the Northlands, and Shudderwood.
[*]Plague Wolfs drop less wolf meat.
[*]Kur now drops horns, and some worn silver armor pieces.
[*]New animations for Boars and Male Deers have been added. [/list]

Weapons:
[list] [*]Weapons have different attack ranges!  Hatchets are the shortest, followed by hammers, then swords and maces, and then two handed weapons with the longest reach.
[*]Weapons now have Encumberance and affect your movement speed.
[*]Two handed weapons have slower animations than before, to match their cooldowns.
[*]Two handed swords have their own animations now. [/list]


[h1] Bug Fixes: [/h1]
[list][*] Building states “popping” when being destroyed fixed
[*]Player camera FOV fixed so weapons do not appear tiny
[*]Ogre ground pound attack FX fixed
[*]Fix for crash when portals are opened
[*]Fix for preplaced building issues
[*]Fix for crafting screen crash when drag & dropping inventory items
[*]Fix for mouse smoothing & resolution reset
[*]Fix for resource nodes not highlighting sometimes
[*]Fix for loot all stealing items from other players
[*]Fix for loot all disabling corpses
[*]Inventory Menu no longer lights up the world around you. [/list]

[h1] Known Issues [/h1]
[list][*]LOD issues with certain objects.
[*]Enemies popping and not pathing correctly.  
[*]Old worlds crashing that had trees and bushes cleared on the third island
[list][*]New worlds created will not have this issue as it is tied to these trees and bushes having been fixed[/list]
[*]Items disappearing when loading old saves
[list][*]Items gained after loading the update will work normally[/list][/list]

[h1] Next Up: [/h1]
[list] [*]Item adding and balancing continues.
[*]More art and design updates to the new world.
[*]Bug fixes. [/list]

tags.feature: Enemy Health Bars can now be toggled “On” in your options. This will give you the information to know if you are equipped with a weapon strong enough for the fights you are trying to pick.
Status Effects have been reworked and updated with new ways to remove these disabilities.
Lord Drackonus is a mysterious and worthy foe that is waiting at night for you to step onto the island of Jormungahr. Are you brave enough to face him?
Flawless Items have been removed from the game entirely.

Babo Shrooms can now be found on all of the islands, eating them causes disease, grinding some up makes babo powder which cures disease, or you can soak less of them in a alchemy cauldron to make a babo potion which also cures disease.

Nightbloom flowers have returned.  There is only 100 of them on the island, each character can only get them once.  5 Nightbloom flowers makes one potion of Kurere, which is the ultimate instant heal.

tags.balance_change:

now takes 30 seconds to get the same healing effect.
Items that cure disease, bleeding, or poison now ALWAYS cure those effects, and do so instantly.
Poison is now low damage with a really long time frame.
Bleed is now high damage with a short time frame.
Disease is completely different now, while diseased you cannot regenerate stamina, and any stamina consuming actions you perform costs double stamina.
Cotton, Babo Shrooms now respawn after 1 game-days worth of time.
All ore nodes respawn after 1/2 game-days worth of time.
Forward movement speed for walking and running has increased.
Day and Night have been updated to make Day time longer than night time.

notes.title: Game Update #33, Build 0.8.3.132, is live!
notes.content:
[h1][b] WARNING [/b][/h1]
The original Sundered Isle's content, which utilized Unity 4, has been [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/307880/discussions/1/412449508295199149/]moved to a Legacy Branch[/url] allowing players to access their old save data and continue playing the old content as they wish. Transferring save data between the Main game branch and the Legacy game branch is not supported.

[h1] Big Changes: [/h1]
New Enemies: Trogres, Grinfels, Ghuuls, and Infernal Eks now roam the Savage world.

[h1] New Features & Patches Notes: [/h1]
[b]Trogres [/b]wield enormous weapons and will smash anything that crosses their path. An unaware Savage that is not prepared for this fight will be no match for these mighty foes!
[b]Grinfels [/b]must consume silver to live. If you find one and kill it, make sure to loot it for this very precious metal.
[b]Ghuuls [/b] scurry and crawl from the shadows of the old towns to rip you limb from limb. 
[b]Infernal Eks [/b]burn fiery rage when compared to their less dangerous greener siblings. 

New items added! Here is a list of all of the new items that have been added or adjusted:
[list][*] A ‘Player Specific Item’ system is now available. This means certain items like ‘Gary’s Tattered Bag’ will be available for every player to pick up on that a server.
[*]Torches and Dim Torches no longer provide the player with warmth.
[*]Weapons now have piercing levels according to their type.
[*]Silver and Gold items are now available.
[*]Heavy Armor now has higher durability than Light Armor.
[*]Heavy Armor now requires a Crafting Table to repair. 
[*]Light Armor can be repaired anywhere but requires the use of a Patching Kit. Patching kits are made from Needles and Sinew.
[*]Needles can now be crafted from Human or Animal Bones.
[*]Chests no longer have the Loot All function.
[*]Flawless items have been removed. They will no longer drop or be craftable. If you currently own one, they are still repairable. [/list]
Art:
[list][*]New art for the islands of Freydalyn and Jormunghar.
[*]Effects have been added to the volcanic vents of Jormunghar.
[*]Hot springs can now be found in Jormunghar.
[*]New towns have been added to Jormunghar.
[*]New icons and art added to the Journal. [/list]

Environment:
[list][*]Water is now less lethal.
[*]New locations added to Freydalyn, and Jormungahr.
[*]Jormunghar now has Silver nodes available.
[*]Cotton can now be found throughout Freydalyn. 
[*]Buildables can now be placed in more areas.
[*]The Monolith has returned… [/list]

Enemies:
[*]New animations have been added for the Skeletons, Wolves, Kiilots and Kruul.
[*]Eldar is now named Eldair.
[*]Furies no longer drop Worn Steel Gear, and instead drop Worn Iron Gear. 
[*]The Forest Giants, Kruul, Chilkoot, Kur, and the Furies have had their stats rebalanced. [/list]

[h1] Bug Fixes: [/h1]
[list][*]Fixed collision issues with portals.
[*]Fixed crash bug that occurred upon killing Kur.
[*]Fixed Forest Giant targeting and health resetting issues.
[*]Fixed several visual bugs related to armor and missing armor.
[*]Fixed the water avoidance for enemy AI. Thus ends the days of the Seadeers. Rest in peace our furred aquatic friends.
[*]Fixed the block system so now pierced shields and armor will still properly block 40% of the damage.
[*]Fixed the "You are no longer freezing." message that was spamming the player chat window.
[*]Dropping an equipped secondary item should now properly update your inventory player model. 
[*]Various crash and network issues have been addressed. [/list]

[h1] [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/307880/discussions/3/458604254449614710/]Known Issues[/url] [/h1]
[list][*]LOD issues with certain objects. [/list]

[h1] Next Up: [/h1]
[list][*]Moving the Beta branch to the Main branch on Monday, March 14th, 2016.
[*]Moving the original game branch to a Legacy branch on Monday, March 14th, 2016.
[*]Item adding and balancing continues.
[*]More art and design updates to the new world.
[*]Bug fixes. [/list]

notes.title: Game Update #32, Build 0.8.3.109 is live only for the Beta!
notes.content:
[h1][b] WARNING [/b][/h1] This update is for the Beta only. The Beta allows you to play on the Islands of Tarvhas which run on the 5.3 Unity engine. Once the content is functional, we will merge the Beta  into the default branch. The Sundered Isles will be moved to a legacy branch for those who would like to play their old saves. Thank you for your patience while we update the game weekly. 
        
[h1] Big Changes: [/h1]
New Item: Shields!
New Enemies: The Dragon Kur. The Devourer. Eldar, Thuum, Grot, and Ket are the four guardians (Forest Giants).

[h1] New Features & Patches Notes: [/h1]
Shields can be crafted and used! When equipped in your off hand, shields protect you from damage. Currently, shields will range from Wooden to Steel.  Shields are a great help when fighting enemies, but they do require stamina and prevent jumping.

Savages! The Dragon Kur has returned and awaits your challenge! It’s probably best to gather your friends before you take on this mighty foe! His loot drops are not yet finalized. Look for this and many other improvements to the encounter in the future.

Eldar, Thuum, Grot, and Ket are the 4 guardians of the Skulls of Power.  Find them, kill them, recover the skulls and open the portal to Jormungahr to face off against the mighty Kur.

The Devourer can now be found in The Wildwoods. Killing him yields Pelts of the Devourer which can be crafted into a set of Devourer Armor.

Kruul Spawning, Opening the Portal, and The Devourer spawning all have gold chat window text that accompanies them.

New items added! Here is a list of all of the new items that have been added or adjusted:
[list][*]New icons and art.
[*]Armor & Shield should now block Poison & Bleeding damage effects.
[*]Shields will block 80% of damage unless pierced, continuing the 20% into Armor/Player.
[*]Damage to armor is now spread out across all worn armor pieces instead of selecting a single random piece.
[*]One Handed Weapons deal roughly half the damage as their Two Handed Counterparts, however they can be swung twice as fast.
[*]Cured, and Smoked Meats have been temporarily disabled until we get their actual crafting setups working.
[*]A large amount of new recipes have been unlocked.
[*]Legacy weapons and armor no longer exist. [/list]

Art:
[list][*] New Wolf and Kiilot attack animations.
[*]New Skeleton movement and attack animations.
[*]New Armor art for Mithras, Crystalline, Dragon Skin, Heavy Tin, Heavy Copper, Heavy Iron, Heavy Bronze and Heavy Steel.
[*]New Weapon art for Battle Axes, War Hammers and War Maces.
[*]All Weapons now have art created all the way up to Steel.
[*]All weapons now have the correct Icons. [/list]

Environment:
[list][*]The Ice Fields no longer deal damage to your armor.
[*]New locations on Freydalyn and Jormungahr 
[*]The concept of dungeons has been implemented in a very minor fashion. Using a soul of a forest giant opens a portal to a dungeon. These dungeons are currently just one room which yields a skull of power. [/list]

Enemies:
[*]Eks now have a chance of dropping Horns.
[*]Plague Wolf Drops have been adjusted. [/list]

[h1] Bug Fixes: [/h1]
[list][*]Fixed the animation sync for other players on hosted servers. You will see what everybody is doing again!
[*]Fixed a crash when saving and loading a player inventory.
[*]"Free" versions of flawless armors have been fixed.
[*]Fixed crashes with Armors, and they now have texture variants.
[*]Forest Giants waking up animations has been fixed.
[*]Enemies losing interest in you after not being able to attack you for a fixed amount of time has been fixed.
[*]Bow textures have been fixed.
[*]Kiilots falling through the world should hopefully be fixed. [/list]

[h1] [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/307880/discussions/3/458604254449614710/]Known Issues[/url]: [/h1]
[list][*]LOD issues with certain objects. [/list]

[h1] Next Up: [/h1]
[list][*]Moving  the Beta branch to the main branch.
[*]Adding and balancing a ton of new items.
[*]More art and design updates to the new world.
[*]Bug fixes. [/list]

tags.feature: New Item: Shields!
New Enemies: The Dragon Kur. The Devourer. Eldar, Thuum, Grot, and Ket are the four guardians (Forest Giants).

Shields can be crafted and used! When equipped in your off hand, shields protect you from damage. Currently, shields will range from Wooden to Steel.  Shields are a great help when fighting enemies, but they do require stamina and prevent jumping.

Savages! The Dragon Kur has returned and awaits your challenge! It’s probably best to gather your friends before you take on this mighty foe! His loot drops are not yet finalized. Look for this and many other improvements to the encounter in the future.
Eldar, Thuum, Grot, and Ket are the 4 guardians of the Skulls of Power.  Find them, kill them, recover the skulls and open the portal to Jormungahr to face off against the mighty Kur.
The Devourer can now be found in The Wildwoods. Killing him yields Pelts of the Devourer which can be crafted into a set of Devourer Armor.
Kruul Spawning, Opening the Portal, and The Devourer spawning all have gold chat window text that accompanies them.
New items added! Here is a list of all of the new items that have been added or adjusted:
New icons and art.

tags.balance_change: Armor & Shield should now block Poison & Bleeding damage effects.

Damage to armor is now spread out across all worn armor pieces instead of selecting a single random piece.
One Handed Weapons deal roughly half the damage as their Two Handed Counterparts, however they can be swung twice as fast.

tags.feature: Cured, and Smoked Meats have been temporarily disabled until we get their actual crafting setups working.
A large amount of new recipes have been unlocked.
Legacy weapons and armor no longer exist.
New Wolf and Kiilot attack animations.
New Skeleton movement and attack animations.
New Armor art for Mithras, Crystalline, Dragon Skin, Heavy Tin, Heavy Copper, Heavy Iron, Heavy Bronze and Heavy Steel.
New Weapon art for Battle Axes, War Hammers and War Maces.
All Weapons now have art created all the way up to Steel.
All weapons now have the correct Icons.

tags.balance_change: The Ice Fields no longer deal damage to your armor.

tags.feature: New locations on Freydalyn and Jormungahr

The concept of dungeons has been implemented in a very minor fashion. Using a soul of a forest giant opens a portal to a dungeon. These dungeons are currently just one room which yields a skull of power.

tags.balance_change: Eks now have a chance of dropping Horns.
Plague Wolf Drops have been adjusted.

tags.bug: Fixed the animation sync for other players on hosted servers. You will see what everybody is doing again!
Fixed a crash when saving and loading a player inventory.
"Free" versions of flawless armors have been fixed.
Fixed crashes with Armors, and they now have texture variants.
Forest Giants waking up animations has been fixed.

[h1] Big Changes: [/h1]
New Enemy: Kiilot
New Item: the Bin of Trashing!

[h1] New Features & Patches Notes: [/h1]
The newest enemy to be found in these Savage Lands is a killot. You might be able to find these fearsome light skinned colored beasts in the newly thickened forests on Freydalyn. 

New Buildable: the Bin of Trashing! Throw your unwanted items into this bin, and after a short period of time they will be destroyed PERMANENTLY, use at your own risk! Each item thrown into the bin resets the deletion timer which is currently set a 1 minute.

New items added! Here is a list of all of the new items that have been added or adjusted:
[list][*]New icons and art.
[*]New tree chopping values to bring up the lower tier items.
[*]Iron Ore is now available.
[*]Initial free items now only spawn one time and you must scavenge for any additional resources.
[*]Recipes for items that cannot be built are now hidden. 
[*]All weapon art updated for all single handed weapons (25+ items) [/list]

Environment:
[list][*]The forests have grown thicker in Freydalyn (Main Island).
[*]Portals guarded by the Forest Giants are now in place, but currently do not grant access to any special location.
[*]More accurate collision for enemy pathing has been added.
[*]Forges must now be crafted and are no longer found active on the Islands of Tarvhas.
[*]Furies now prowl the paths and hills around Mt. Drackonus, Dersata, and the Eldar wall. [/list]

New locations:
[list][*] Eldar
[*]The Wildwoods
[*]Weald
[*]Dersata
[*]Mt. Drackonus [/list]

Enemies:
[*]Eldar the Forest Keeper can now be on the main island of Freydalyn.
[*]Snowmere now becomes more difficult once you travel to Freydalyn.
[*]Opening the portal to Freydalyn now stops Kruul and his skeleton guards from spawning in Saval.
[*]Forest Stalkers now prowl the starter island at night.
[*]Enemy spawns and spawn rates have been adjusted.
[*]Drop rates for Flawless Animal Skin, Amber, and Flawless Amber have been increased.
[*]Drop rates for Clay, and Whetstones has been slightly reduced.
[*]Hostile Non-Fauna Enemies no longer flinch.
[*]The wolves standard attack is now a lunging attack. Their quick bite is a higher damage attack with a longer cooldown.
[*]Wolves, Adult Boars and other creatures have all had their sizes adjusted to help them stand out more.
[*]Enemies previously known as Gremlins are now referred to as “Eks” and can be found on Snowmere near Sentinel Hill. [/list]

[h1] Bug Fixes: [/h1]
[list][*]Killing enemies that drop Spirit Shards and Spirit Orbs no longer crashes the game.
[*]Various enemy animation fixes and updates to multiple creatures.
[*]Some enemies that had a chance to deal multiple attacks worth of damage in a single attack have been fixed to only deal damage once. [/list]

[h1] Known Issues [/h1]
[list][*]LOD issues with certain objects. [/list]

[h1] Next Up: [/h1]
[list][*]Adding and balancing a ton of new items.
[*]More art and design updates to the new world.
[*]Bug fixes.[/list]

notes.title: Game Update #30, Build 0.8.3.78 is live only for Beta!
notes.content:
[h1][b] WARNING [/b][/h1] This update is only for the Beta. The Beta allows you to play on the islands Tarvhas which runs on the 5.3 Unity engine. After the content is all functional, we will move the Beta build to the default branch (the main build). At that point, the Sundered Isles will be moved to a legacy branch for those that want to use your old saves. Thank you for your patience during this time as we rapidly update the title. 
	
[h1] Big Changes: [/h1]
Player Summoning!
New Items Added!

[h1] New Features & Patches Notes: [/h1]
You can now use rare objects to summon other players to your current location! 
[list][*]Spirit Shards can now be used to teleport a player to you one time before becoming broken. [/list]
[list][*]Spirit Orbs can now be used to teleport a player to you an infinite amount of times. [/list]
[list][*]Spirit Shards and Spirit Orbs now require at least 25% stamina to teleport and consume ALL of your available stamina on teleportation activation. [/list]

New items added! Here is a list of all of the new items that have been added or adjusted:
[list][*]Pine Strong Box, and Enchanted Chest is now in the crafting menu (k) and they are dropped by throwing it on the ground again. [/list]
[list][*]Ice chunks can be crafted into water (Water is currently only used to build a cauldron). [/list]
[list][*]Tannin can now be crafted with just a crafting table. [/list]
[list][*]Weapons are now repaired with Whetstones. [/list]
[list][*]Armor is now repaired with Repair Hammers. [/list]
[list][*]Repair Hammers can now be crafted with 1 Rock, 1 Wood Stick, and 1 Sinew. [/list]
[list][*]Weapon attack cooldowns have been adjusted. [/list]
[list][*]Weapons now have Worn and Flawless Versions. [/list]
[list][*]Armors now have Worn Versions. [/list]
[list][*]Worn versions of armor and weapons cannot be crafted and are the only armor and weapon items currently found placed in the world or on enemies. [/list]
[list][*]Planks have been added and can be crafted with 4 logs to get 2 wooden planks. [/list]
[list][*]Nails can now be crafted with Tin Ingots and a Forge. [/list]
[list][*]Stone Slabs can now be crafted at a Crafting Table by combining 1 Clay with 4 Rocks. [/list]

Buildable changes for this update:
[list][*]Pine Strong Box is now an item again, and not a buildable like buildings. [/list]
[list][*]Dragon Forge build requirements are updated. [/list]
[list][*]Buildings placed too close to Pre Placed Buildables (currently the Campfire) no longer cause the game to crash. [/list]
[list][*]All buildings no longer require LQ/MQ/HQ Ores, and now require equivalent new ores. [/list]
[list][*]Forge, Smelter, Cauldron, Crafting Table, and Workbench build requirements have been updated. [/list]
[list][*]Buildables have been updated to reduce the occurrence of building a buildable on top of another buildable. [/list]
[list][*]Stone Slabs and Clay are now used to build Stone Buildings. [/list]

Enemies
[list][*]Furies no longer drop Iron Ore, and instead drop Spirit Shards. [/list]

Trees
[list][*]Now cut down like resource nodes (take multiple hits to remove chunks) based on weapon tier. [/list]

Resource Nodes
[list][*]Glaciers in the Ice Shelf can be mined for Ice Chunks. [/list]
[list][*]When mining rocks you now have a chance to get Whetstone and Clay. [/list]
[list][*]All Non Rock and Ice Resource Nodes now have a red glow when you are close to them and looking directly at them. [/list]

Environment
[list][*]The Ice Shelf is much colder than before. [/list]
[list][*]The Islands in general are colder than before. [/list]
[list][*]Reduced frequency of Stormy Weather. [/list]
[list][*]Portal from Snowmere to Freydalyn art has been updated. [/list]

[h1] Bug Fixes: [/h1]
Fixed crashes with the bows and arrows.	
Fixed a crash with the Forge.
Fixed items being deleted from the Pine Strong Box.
Fixed a bug with hunger so that you now take damage when you are fully hungry.

[h1] Known Issues: [/h1]
LOD issues with certain objects.

[h1] Next Up: [/h1]
Adding and balancing a ton of new items.
More art and design updates to the new world.
Bug fixes.

Armors now have Worn Versions.
Worn versions of armor and weapons cannot be crafted and are the only armor and weapon items currently found placed in the world or on enemies.
Planks have been added and can be crafted with 4 logs to get 2 wooden planks.
Nails can now be crafted with Tin Ingots and a Forge.
Stone Slabs can now be crafted at a Crafting Table by combining 1 Clay with 4 Rocks.
Pine Strong Box is now an item again, and not a buildable like buildings.

tags.balance_change: Dragon Forge build requirements are updated.

tags.bug: Buildings placed too close to Pre Placed Buildables (currently the Campfire) no longer cause the game to crash.

tags.balance_change: All buildings no longer require LQ/MQ/HQ Ores, and now require equivalent new ores.
Forge, Smelter, Cauldron, Crafting Table, and Workbench build requirements have been updated.
Buildables have been updated to reduce the occurrence of building a buildable on top of another buildable.

tags.feature: Stone Slabs and Clay are now used to build Stone Buildings.

tags.balance_change: Furies no longer drop Iron Ore, and instead drop Spirit Shards.
Now cut down like resource nodes (take multiple hits to remove chunks) based on weapon tier.

tags.feature: Glaciers in the Ice Shelf can be mined for Ice Chunks.
When mining rocks you now have a chance to get Whetstone and Clay.
All Non Rock and Ice Resource Nodes now have a red glow when you are close to them and looking directly at them.

tags.balance_change: The Ice Shelf is much colder than before.
The Islands in general are colder than before.
Reduced frequency of Stormy Weather.

tags.feature: Portal from Snowmere to Freydalyn art has been updated.

tags.bug: Fixed crashes with the bows and arrows.
Fixed a crash with the Forge.
Fixed items being deleted from the Pine Strong Box.
Fixed a bug with hunger so that you now take damage when you are fully hungry.

notes.title: Game Update #28, Build 0.8.3.58 is live only for Beta!
notes.content:
[h1] [b] WARNING [/b] [/h1] This update is only for the Beta. The Beta is currently allowing play on the new islands in Unity 5.3 . Old character saves are not supported in the Beta branch until we update the save system which is slated for an update on 2/11/16 . We will look into moving the Sundered Isles to a legacy branch for those that want to return to the once this transition happens. Thank you for your patience. 
	
[h1] Big Changes: [/h1]
-	Travel By Portal!
-	Weather Is Back!

 [h1] New Features & Patches Notes: [/h1]
-	Travel by Portal! The bridge that required the ‘Skull of Lord Kruul’ has now been replaced with a portal system that currently allows fast travel from the first island to the second island. As we work out the kinks with this new interisland travel system, the portal will remain open by default for the week. Keep in mind it’s all placeholder art for now. We welcome any and all feedback you may have with this new approach to island hopping.
-	Weather is Back! This feature has been added into the Beta branch. There are still a few bits of polish to work out (audio and visuals) but please hit up the forums and/or our Trello board and let us know what weather you would like to see affect the Savage Islands in the future.
 -	Several new art updates to inventory icons.
-	Stamina consumption while sprinting has been reduced so you can now sprint further than before.
-	Performance Optimizations. Overall, we are seeing improvements in the ballpark of 10-15 fps. Some of the specifics we looked into this week were culling distances, LOD’s and reflection optimization.
-	Enemy placement has been adjusted across the first two islands.
-	Item Placement has been adjusted across the first two islands.
-	Driftwood piles can now be harvested for logs and sticks. We will be populating the islands with more of these items in the following weeks.
-	Art updates to the islands continues, for the most part this update focused on the second and third island.
-	New first person sprinting animations have been implemented allowing you to see less weapon and hands in your view when sprinting.
-	Tooltips now show on crafting items as well as the Journal.
-	Where am I? Pressing L will now show your location coordinates.

[h1] Bug Fixes: [/h1]
-	Fixed a item disappearing/duplication bug. This occurred when placing items in the action bar from your inventory.
-	Fixed crashes with tabs in the journal, crafting tabs and inventory UI.
-	Fixed several “invisible buildings” issues.
-	Fixed a collision issue in Freydalyn to avoid getting stuck near walls.
-	Fixed a collision issue that prevented players from reliably entering and exiting the updated Wooden House.
-	Gathering resources with axes and hammers now subtract the right amount of durability.

 [h1] Known Issues: [/h1]
-	Crashes with old characters and old world saves.
-	LOD issues with certain objects. 

[h1] Next Up: [/h1]
-	The new “Save System” added.
-	Adding and balancing a ton of new items.
-	More art and design updates to the new world.
-	Bug fixes.

notes.title: Game Update #26, Build 0.8.3.28 is live only for Beta!
notes.content:
[h1] [b] WARNING [/b] [/h1] This update is only for the Beta which includes the new islands of Tarvhas and unity 5. Old character saves are not supported in the Beta branch until we update the save system. We will look into moving the old world to a legacy branch for those that want to return to the Sundered Isles once this transition happens.

[h1] Big Changes: [/h1]
-	Ice and Glaciers Added to the Ocean
-	Dedicated Servers Working in the Beta

[h1] New Features & Patches Notes: [/h1]
-	The oceans now have ice chucks for you to walk on. You will also notice large glaciers that are currently uninhabited, for now…
-	Health/Cold and Stamina/Hunger system has had some tweaks. Cold is now less harsh. Jump no longer drains stamina. Stamina now lasts longer so you can run longer. You require less food to survive.
-	Dedicated servers are up and working for the Beta. Let us know if you have any specific issues hosting them.
-	New Animations have been added for bandages and off-hand object use.
-	A ton of new recipes have gone into the game. Even more will be added in the weeks to come. 
-	Art and Design updates and changes to the islands of Tarvhas. The content continues to improve and be added to each week.
-	Several improvements for performance have been made for Unity 5.3

 [h1] Known Issues: [/h1]
-	Crashes with old characters and old world saves.
-	LOD issues with certain objects. 

[h1] Next Up: [/h1]
-	The new “Save System” to fix crashes.
-	Balance updates new items.
-	More Art and Design updates and changes to the islands of Tarvhas.
-	Bug fixes.

notes.title: Game Update #25, Build 0.8.3.23 is live only for Beta!
notes.content:
[h1] [b] WARNING [/b] [/h1] This update is only for the Beta which is the new island and unity 5. Old character saves are not supported in the Beta branch moving forward. We will look into moving the old world to a legacy branch for those that want to return to the Sundered Isles once this transition happens.

[h1] Big Changes: [/h1]
-	UI Overhaul
-	New Cold/Health and Stamina/Hunger System
-	Unity 5.3 Integration Improvements

[h1] New Features & Patches Notes: [/h1]
-	The UI is new and improved! We have gone through just about everything and there are still a few adjustments and additions that you will see in upcoming weeks.
-	Hunger/Cold and Stamina/Hunger are now grouped together on the UI and work together on a “give and take”. If you are too cold or hungry, your health and stamina can only go so high. Once you have taken care of your cold and hunger, you will need to let your stamina fill. Your health on the other hand will need to be refilled with food or bandages.
-	Art and Design updates and changes to the new world. The content continues to improve and be added to each week.
-	Several improvements for performance have been made for Unity 5.3

 [h1] Known Issues: [/h1]
-	Crashes with old characters and old world saves.
-	LOD issues with certain objects.
-	Dedicated servers not currently working the beta. 
-	Animals can and will run into the ocean. The Sea-Deer have returned to us.

[h1] Next Up: [/h1]
-	Save improvements to fix crashes.
-	UI adjustments .
-	Balance updates new items.
-	More Art and Design updates and changes to the new world.
-	Bug fixes.

[h1]This Game Update is now LIVE to ALL PLAYERS![/h1]

[h1]FIXED[/h1]
[b] Lots of bug fixes (thanks to the community for finding and reporting these!)[/b]
[list][*] Text descriptions on weapons no longer extend past the Journal boundaries
[*]Broken Crafted Chain armor no longer uses the wrong icon
[*]All helms should now correctly render the players face when worn[/list]

[h1]ADDED[/h1]
[b][u]General:[/u][/b]
[list][*] All rocks but the giant pillars and large piles (used to mark spawn area or to delineate specific areas) will disappear when mined out.
[*]General performance tweaks[/list]

[b][u]Crafting[/u][/b]
[list][*]All components including Ore degrade after 40 minutes while left in the open world
[*]Everwood and storage bags will not degrade over time
[*]Items in Pine Strong Boxes or bags will not degrade over time[/list]

[b][u]Creatures[/u][/b]
[list][*]Forest Gremlins added to the world. Gremlins can be found in:
[list][*]All ruin locations
[*]All village locations
[*]Misc creatures spawners
[*]Gremlins vary in type and damage
[*]Drops contain random loot[/list]
[*]Forest Giant attacks updated
[list][*]Ground pound affects all players in a radius[/list][/list]

[b][u]Equipment[/u][/b]
[list][*] Mace/blunt weapons can now chop down small bushes
[*]Broken weapons and armor degrade after 40 minutes while left in the open 
[list][*] This does not mean damaged items; ONLY items labelled as "Broken"[/list]
[/list]

[h1]Don't forget to click [b][url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/307880]FOLLOW[/url][/b] on the main store page to receive event reminders and the latest news about the game.[/h1]

notes.title: Game Update #16: Version 0.8.0, Build 18009
notes.content:
[img]http://www.savagelandsgame.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/04/Update-1024x550.png[/img]

[h1][b]This build is NOW AVAILABLE to ALL PLAYERS[/b][/h1]



[b]New Update! New Version Number!

New servers![/b]
[i]Reminder to ALL players:[/i]
We do not advise you attempt to move a previously peer-hosted or single player world to a new dedicated world - there is *great* potential for data loss. We encourage you to start new worlds for a dedicated server to avoid issues!


[h1]DEDICATED SERVER NOTES: [/h1]
[h1]ADDED:[/h1]
[list][*]Dedicated server functionality ([url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/307880/discussions/1/490123938432395004/]Installation instructions available HERE[/url])[/list]



[h1]GENERAL PATCH NOTES:[/h1]
[h1]FIXED:[/h1]
[b]Lots of bug fixes (thanks to the community for finding and reporting these!)[/b]
[list][*] Confirmation window now appears when the player is about to overwrite an existing character or world
[*]Gremlins no longer inhabit the VOIP!
[*]Helion once again is able to pierce Ebon Steel Armor
[*]Sorted out several incorrect item icons, they now use the correct ones
[*]Resolved an bug causing a perf issue
[*]Creatures will spawn in Oscira again
[*]Forest Giants now spawn at night again
[/list]


[h1]ADDED:[/h1]
[b][u]General:[/u][/b]
[list][*]DRAGON FIGHT! Summon Kur to his death (or yours!)
[list][*]Build 18009 introduces additional tweaks to this encounter 
[/list]
[*]Pine Strong Box are now only accessible by the owning player on dedicated servers. This feature can be turned on/off by server host. 
[list][*]If the option is on, it is "locked" for anyone else on the server, except the player who crafted it
[*]If it is off, all players can access what is in the chest[/list]
[*]New audio when the player is being burned
[/list]


[b][u]Crafting:[/u][/b]
[list][*]Starting clothes can be crafted into Cloth Shreds.
[*]Additional Frost Fern spawners added to the world
[*]Increased drops rates of Frost Berries, Sundered Tree Nuts, and Sundered Cotton
[*]Pine Strong Box Sinew requirement changed to coal
[*]Small Dragon Scale bag is now craftable
[list][*]Dragon Scales now drop randomly throughout the Sundered Isle[/list]
[/list]


[b][u]Creatures:[/u][/b]
[list][*]AI pathing between trees has been improved. Creatures should not get stuck any more
[*]Goats have been added into the creature population
[*]Spirit Wolves:
[list][*]Increased spirit wolf damage by 15%
[*]Increased spawn rate of Spirit wolves[/list]
[*]Forest Giants:
[list][*]Forest Giants now cause bleeding damage on swipe
[*]Forest giant swipe has a chance to pierce Ebon Steel armor[/list]
[*]Undead Furies now cause inflict bleed damage on the player
[*]Draemar:
[list][*]Draemar now does additional cold and disease damage
[*]Draemar now turns to target quicker[/list]
[/list]


[b][u]Equipment:[/u][/b]
[list][*] Spirit Blade, Soul Storm and Rage Bane added[/list]




[b][url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/307880/discussions/3/]Found a BUG? Post it HERE:[/url][/b]

notes.title: Game Update # 15: Version 0.7.0, Build 17863
notes.content:
[img]http://www.savagelandsgame.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/04/Update-1024x550.png[/img]



[h1][b]NOTE FROM THE DEVELOPERS:[/b][/h1]

Characters created with the new Character Customizer are [b][u]NOT[/u][/b] backwards compatible. if you attempt to load a newly created character into an older world, it has the potential of causing data loss from the old world. 

This will not change going forward. If you create a new world (with a new character), you should be able to log in with an older character and "ferry" your existing materials to the new world.

[b]Also:[/b] IF you create a character with the new customizer, and name it the same as an existing, it will [b]OVERWRITE[/b] the existing character and you will loose all items on the original character.


[b]This build is now available to ALL PLAYERS[/b]




[h1]FIXED:[/h1]
[b]Lots of bug fixes (thanks to the community for finding and reporting these!)[/b]
[list][*]Firepit SFX no longer can be heard across the map
[*]Fixed issues with color flickering while gloves were equipped
	[list][*]Known issue - Studded leather wraps use regular skin texture[/list]
[/list]


[h1]ADDED:[/h1]
[b][u]General:[/u][/b]
[list][*]Character customizer Phase 1 - (Phase 3 of overall Character design!)
[list][*]Shader Quality of “Good” or better required to view colorization changes during character creations[/list]
[*]New audio SFX for menus
[/list]


[b][u]Crafting:[/u][/b]
[list][*]Coal & Flint drops rebalanced
[*]Required Materials rebalanced for the following items:
	[list][*]Wolfsbane
	[*]Fleshbound Hammer
	[*]Reckless Edge
		[List][*]Increased tree cutting efficiency from 3 to 4[/list]
	[*]Blackend Steel Sword
	[*]Savage Steel Cleaver
	[*]Grey Reaver
	[*]The Sundered Oathblade
	[*]Flesh Ripper
	[*]Executioners Armor
	[*]Ebon Steel Armor[/list]
[*]General tweaks to item spawn times
[/list]


[b][u]Creatures:[/u][/b]
[list][*]Piglets added to start area of map (Watch out for Mama!)
[*]Deer rebalanced
[*]New dragon audio
[*]Updated droppers for Spirit Wolves and Draemar. Multiple orbs now have a chance of dropping  
[*]Adjusted boar spawn rate 
[*]Tweaked Draemar area effects to mitigate performance  loss while in proximity[/list]


[b][u]Environment:[/u][/b]
[list][*]Befallen has been revamped, creature spawns updated
[*]Ruins of Oscira in place of previous town of Oscira[/list]


[b][u]Equipment:[/u][/b]
[list][*]Executioners & Ebon Steel armor durability stats increased
[*]Ebon Steel Armor heat stats increased
[*]Updated audio for Longbow
[/list]
