notes.title: A Reaver Renamed! Introducting...
notes.content:
[img]http://www.savagelandsgame.com/wp-content/uploads/2015/06/GoldenReaver-1024x639.jpg[/img]

[h1][b]...The Sundered Oathblade![/b][/h1]

As suggested by Community Member, [b]ArcaneStone[/b]:

[i]Possibly, part of the reason Lycor was able to face Kur was because he was somehow related to the Ents, the tree giants. The Ents accepted him as kin, a brother, and gifted him this blade after its creation, to help defeat Kur. A proof of the bond between them, they pacted in the old way. Sap and blood leaped from the king of the Ents and Lycor (respectively) after the wounds had been given for the pact, and bonded together, sap hardened, blood surged, and the blade grew from where it hit the ground. The Sundered Oathblade was proof of the combined strength of the Isles against the terror of Kur.[/i]


[b]Congratulation ArcaneStone![/b]


Check out the rest of the awesome suggestions, [url=http://www.savagelandsgame.com/reavercontest/]on the Official Savage Lands Website![/url]

tags.feature: The Sundered Oathblade!

notes.title: Game Update #10: Version 0.7.0, Build 17525
notes.content:
[h1]This Game Update is now LIVE to ALL PLAYERS!![/h1]

[h1]FIXED:[/h1]
[b]Lots of bug fixes (thanks to the community for finding and reporting these!)[/b]
[list][*]Fixed issues with armor not always appearing
[*]Fixed issue with compass disappearing
[*]Improvements and fixes to trees catching on fire
[*]Improvements to general  AI behavior
[*]Skeletons will now actively attack again, instead of standing there like brainless Zombies until aggro'd by the player  
[*]"They Only Come Out at Night"  now properly tracks  all Undead Fury kills, across multiple play sessions
[/list]


[h1]ADDED:[/h1]
[b][u]General:[/u][/b]
[list][*]Additional Shadow Settings, for gameplay optimization 
[list][*]Toggle between Hard and Soft shadows
[*]Set draw distance for shadows[/list][/list]

[b][u]Achievements:[/u][/b]
[list][*]New SFX for Achievements completion[/list]


[b][u]Crafting:[/u][/b]
[list][*]Golden Reaver: Amber material  repair requirement increased to 3
[*]Long Bow material requirements have been reduced
[*]Radiant Gem Stack Count increased from 3 to 15[/list]


[b][u]Creatures:[/u][/b]
[list][*][b]Kur will now attack player while in flight!  Beware![/b]
[*]Deer are less skittish, still requires players to sneak up on them
[*]Special Creatures:
	[list][*]Helion (yellow eyes), a new Fury NPC boss has been added to the game
		[*]Lycor:
			[list][*]Health increased 60%
			[*]Attacks no longer randomly do damage
			[*]Spawn rate decreased[/list]
		[*]Ragnok: 
			[list][*]Damaged increased by 15%
			[*]Health increased by 30%[/list]
			[*]Ragnok and Lycor encounters rebalanced[/list]
	[/list]
[*]Undead Fury health increased by 20%
[*]All Fury item drops rebalanced
	[list][*]Fury Battle Satchel added (10 Slot Bag, Dropped only by Furies)[/list]
[/list]





[h1]Please post bugs [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/307880/discussions/3/]here![/url][/h1]

notes.title: Game Update #8: Version 0.6.0, Build 17382
notes.content:
[h1]THIS UPDATE IS NOW LIVE TO ALL PLAYERS!![/h1]


[h1]FIXED:[/h1]
[b]Lots of bug fixes (thanks to the community for finding and reporting these!)[/b]
[list][*]Lycor's spawner has been fixed - for realz
[*]Item spawners in villages have be tuned based on area
[*]Issues with rock colliders in center of the island 
[*]Additional SFX for player 
[*]Corpse moniker UI distance increased by 3X 
[*]Ragnok drop no longer crashes game[/list]



[h1]ADDED:[/h1]
[b][u]General:[/u][/b]
[list][*]Bestiary now unlocked
[*]Something has been busy around the monolith as though preparing for something… 
[*]Additional camps have been added to the map
[*]Old Ruins props have been removed and replaced with new versions that better fit the world
[*]Repair materials needed for weapons and armor have been rebalanced
[*]Players now react to taking damage and landing blows
[*]Rotation speed on structures increased by 75%[/list]


[b][u]Crafting:[/u][/b]
[list][*]Structures built by the player can now be destroyed and decay over time. Players will get back some of the components they put into the structure they destroy
	[list][*]Durability – Defines how strong the structure
	[*]Repair: How long a structure has (in game days) before it requires materials for repair[/list]
[/list]


[b][u]Creatures:[/u][/b]
[list][*]AI system has been revamped
	[list][*]Creatures now longer run into the water
	[*]Creatures should no longer get stuck on objects
	[*]Creatures will do a better job of attacking a player that is moving backwards
	[*]Creature attack ranges have been tuned 
	[*]Proper animations are now being used for each creature (cycle through different attack animations making creatures look more unique)[/list]
[*]Forest Giant: 
	[list][*]New SFX added for Forest Giant Death
	[*]Two new additional attacks[/list]
[*]Skeletons:
	[list][*]Tortured Skeletons now come in two flavors (armed and unarmed)
		[list][*]Armed versions will drop the weapons they carry[/list]
	[*]Undead Furies have two new attack types[/list]
[*]Wolves:
	[list][*]Wolves have small and large bite attacks
	[*]Hill Stalker general attack cool-down increased by 10%
	[*]Dire Wolf damage increased by 10%
	[*]Dire Wolf health increased from 60 to 75[/list]
[*]Dire Bears:
	[list][*]Dire Bear now use multiple attacks
	[*]Dire Bear damage reduced by 30%[/list]
[*]Special Creatures have been revamped:
	[list][*]Ragnok textures have been updated with a new look to help him stand out among the other Tortured Skeletons
	[*]Lycor textures have been updated with a new look to help him stand out among the Undead Furies.[/list]
[/list]


[b][u]Environment:[/u][/b]
[list][*]Small bushes can now be chopped with swords[/list]


[b][u]Equipment:[/u][/b]
[list][*]Rotted Oak Smasher (Ragnok's weapon):
	[list][*]Rotted Oak Smasher texture updated
	[*]Rotted Oak Smasher stats increased[/list]
[*]Savage Steel Cleaver:
	[list][*]Damage increased to 40
	[*]Durability damage increased to 380[/list]
[*]Golden Reaver: 
	[list][*]Damage increased to 50
	[*]Durability damage increased to 430[/list]
[*]Flesh Ripper: 
	[list][*]Now uses correct model
	[*]Flesh Ripper damage increased to 43
	[*]Flesh Ripper durability increased to 400[/list]
[/list]


Dedicated threads for Feedback and Bug on the following topics:
[list][*][url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/307880/discussions/1/620712999972866172/]Demoltion System: Bugs & Feedback[/url]
[*][url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/307880/discussions/1/620712999972860114/]Creature AI System 2.0 - Bugs & Feedback![/url]
[*][url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/307880/discussions/1/620712999972875391/]Decay System - Bugs & Feedback[/url][/list]


[h1]Please post GENERAL BUGS that are not related to the above selected topics in the [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/307880/discussions/3/620712999972912784/]BUGS FORUM![/url][/h1]

notes.title: Savage Lands Now Available for OSX, Linux and SteamOS
notes.content:
[h1][b]As of today, we are thrilled to add support for Mac OS, Linux and SteamOS platforms![/b]

With the addition of these new platforms, we reach another milestone on our Development Roadmap, and more players can share in the brutality of [i]Savage Lands[/i]![/h1]

For gamers who have previously played [i]Savage Lands[/i] but who now want to move their game to their Mac/Linux/Steam machines, it's easy:

[list][*]Provided you have not disabled Steam Cloud while previously playing [i]Savage Lands[/i], your gamesaves will be available to you once the game is installed![/list]


[i]Welcome to the Savage Lands, Mac, Linux and SteamOS Players![/i]



[h1]Game Update #7 is now LIVE to all players and adds the following functionality:[/h1]

[h1]FIXED:[/h1]
[b]Plenty of bug fixes (thanks to the community for finding and reporting these!)[/b]
[list][*]Resolved issue with the reading/writing of inventory items (or pickups) which was causing crashes and potentially damaging save files.
[*]Golden Reaver now has correct icon
[*]Stone House should no longer float in air when constructed
[*]Weapon rack in Argo should visually spawn weapons again
[*]Floating props in Argo no longer float 
[*]Repair system changes:
	[list][*]Items now correctly count down at the first sign of damage 
[*]Items now correctly show how many materials are needed & how many are currently in inventory
[*]Text from "Required Components" to "Broken Components" when in repair. 
[*]Bug that was restoring health to items from old players/worlds.[/list]
[/list]


[h1]ADDED:[/h1]
[b][u]General:[/u][/b]
[list][*][b]Mac OS, Linux and Steam OS Support added[/b]
[*]New UI element added to make corpse retrieval less frustrating
	[list][*]When within 200+ meters of your corpse, a crossbones icon will appear on your screen![/list]
[*]Repair system for weapons & armor implemented 
[list][*]Accessed via new tab under Crafting menu
[*]Repairs can only be made after weapons & armor have 'broken'
[*]New camp added to the north of start location 1
[*]Torch now displays health on icon
[*]Torches should now burnout properly when held or on the ground[/list][/list]

[b][u]Crafting:[/u][/b]
[list][*]Pike of Resurrection animation tuned to shake more slowly upon activation [/list]

[b][u]Creatures:[/u][/b]
[list][*]Forest Giants now use a new trigger system to spawn
[*]Adjusted day/night skeletons that spawn around the Argo Dragon Tower[/list]

[b][u]Environment:[/u][/b]
[list][*]Two new additional abandoned camps have been added near Argo Dragon Tower 
[*]Giant rocks pillars have been added in the center isle to help make the area more recognizable. 
[list][*]These rock pillars have been removed from other areas of the island.[/list][/list]

[b][u]Equipment:[/u][/b]
[list][*]Flesh Wrapped Hammer has a new gold texture for metal component
[*]Reckless Edge has been re-textured
[*]Ebon Steel Recipe revamped
[*]Ebon Steel Armor durability increased by 20 for all pieces 
Executioner’s Armor Recipe revamped
[*]Executioner’s Armor durability increased by 10 for all pieces [/list]



[h1][url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/307880/discussions/3/618459405713467866/]Please post bugs here[/url][/h1]

notes.content:
[h1]Game Update #5: Version 0.4.0, Build 17082[/h1]
[b]THIS IS NOW LIVE TO ALL PLAYERS[/b]


[h1]An Important Note About PVP:[/h1]
Currently, the option for the Host to switch the server settings between Hostile and Friendly remains possible after a game has been hosted. We are very aware that this could present opportunities for griefing, and as such [b]we will address this[/b]. Thank you for your understanding!


[h1]ADDED:[/h1]
[b][u]General:[/u][/b]
[list][*]PVP Added!
[list][*]Game Hosts can choose to set their servers to Friendly (Co-op) or Hostile (PvP)[/list]
[*]Player Sprint speed increased by 10%[/list]

	
[b][u]Art, Visual FX and UI:[/u][/b]
[list][*]Reduced ambient volume on the Pike of Resurrection[/list]
	

[b][u]Crafting:[/u][/b]
[list][*]Lower quality ore can be smelted Into higher quality ore
[*]Pine Strong Box
[list][*]Slots increased to 30
[*] Medium Quality metal ore requirement changed to Low Quality ore
[*]Sinew material requirements changed to strong sinew[/list]
[*]Charcoal added to game
[*]Individual arrows can now be crafted.
[*]Flesh Wrapped Bag now uses correct icons
[*]Decayed flesh drop rates on skeletons have been reduced
[*]Cloth Shreds
[list][*]Drop rates on skeletons and in villages has been reduced
[*]Sundered Cotton can now be collected from plants in the world
[*]Cloth shreds can now be made from Sundered Cotton[/list]
[*]Reduce the amount of hits required to mine ore from larger rocks
[*]Coal now drops in stacks of 3
[*]New Buildable Items Added
[list][*]Banner of Conquest
[*]Wooden Crucifix
[*]Wooden Cage
[*]Weapon Rack[/list][/list]
	

[b][u]Creatures:[/u][/b]
[list][*]Enemy creature spawners have been rebalanced in the areas of Argo.[/list]

[b][u]Environment:[/u][/b]
[list][*]Start locations redesigned (now closer to each other)
[*]More camps added to the world
[*]Three giant rock pillars have been added to the west end and east end of the start locations. These signify players are leaving the borders of relative safety and heading out into more [i]Savage[/i] lands
[*]Trees now catch on fire and burn
[list][*]Burned trees have will now drop charcoal[/list][/list]

[b][u]Equipment:[/u][/b]
[list][*]Torches will now decay when dropped on the ground
[*]Armor and weapons now have piercing values
[*]Wolfsbane coal material requirement reduced 
[*]Reckless Edge material requirement reduced 
[*]Blackened Ebon Steel Sword
[list][*]Blackened Steel Sword renamed to Blackened Ebon Steel Sword
[*]Blackened Ebon Steel Sword set to rare
[*]Blackened Ebon Steel Sword damage increased from 24 to 32
[*]Blackened Ebon Steel Sword recipe material requirement rebalanced to compensate for changes to rarity[/list]
[*]Savage Ebon Steel Cleaver
[list][*]Savage Steel Cleaver renamed to Savage Ebon Steel Cleaver
[*]Savage Ebon Steel Cleaver damage increased from 36 to 38
[*]Savage Ebon Steel Cleaver durability increased from 350 to 360[/list][/list]

[h1]ADDED:[/h1]
[b][u]General:[/u][/b]
[list][*]PVP Added!
[list][*]Game Hosts can choose to set their servers to Friendly (Co-op) or Hostile (PvP)[/list]
[*]Player Sprint speed increased by 10%[/list]

	
[b][u]Art, Visual FX and UI:[/u][/b]
[list][*]Reduced ambient volume on the Pike of Resurrection[/list]
	

[b][u]Crafting:[/u][/b]
[list][*]Lower quality ore can be smelted Into higher quality ore
[*]Pine Strong Box
[list][*]Slots increased to 30
[*] Medium Quality metal ore requirement changed to Low Quality ore
[*]Sinew material requirements changed to strong sinew[/list]
[*]Charcoal added to game
[*]Individual arrows can now be crafted.
[*]Flesh Wrapped Bag now uses correct icons
[*]Decayed flesh drop rates on skeletons have been reduced
[*]Cloth Shreds
[list][*]Drop rates on skeletons and in villages has been reduced
[*]Sundered Cotton can now be collected from plants in the world
[*]Cloth shreds can now be made from Sundered Cotton[/list]
[*]Reduce the amount of hits required to mine ore from larger rocks
[*]Coal now drops in stacks of 3
[*]New Buildable Items Added
[list][*]Banner of Conquest
[*]Wooden Crucifix
[*]Wooden Cage
[*]Weapon Rack[/list][/list]
	

[b][u]Creatures:[/u][/b]
[list][*]Enemy creature spawners have been rebalanced in the areas of Argo.[/list]

[b][u]Environment:[/u][/b]
[list][*]Start locations redesigned (now closer to each other)
[*]More camps added to the world
[*]Three giant rock pillars have been added to the west end and east end of the start locations. These signify players are leaving the borders of relative safety and heading out into more [i]Savage[/i] lands
[*]Trees now catch on fire and burn
[list][*]Burned trees have will now drop charcoal[/list][/list]

[b][u]Equipment:[/u][/b]
[list][*]Torches will now decay when dropped on the ground
[*]Armor and weapons now have piercing values
[*]Wolfsbane coal material requirement reduced 
[*]Reckless Edge material requirement reduced 
[*]Blackened Ebon Steel Sword
[list][*]Blackened Steel Sword renamed to Blackened Ebon Steel Sword
[*]Blackened Ebon Steel Sword set to rare
[*]Blackened Ebon Steel Sword damage increased from 24 to 32
[*]Blackened Ebon Steel Sword recipe material requirement rebalanced to compensate for changes to rarity[/list]
[*]Savage Ebon Steel Cleaver
[list][*]Savage Steel Cleaver renamed to Savage Ebon Steel Cleaver
[*]Savage Ebon Steel Cleaver damage increased from 36 to 38
[*]Savage Ebon Steel Cleaver durability increased from 350 to 360[/list][/list]

notes.title: Early Access Game Update #3: Version 0.2.8, Build 16777
notes.content:
[h1]This update is now LIVE TO ALL players.[/h1]


[h1]FIXED:[/h1]
[b]Lots of bug fixes (thanks to the community for finding and reporting these!)[/b]
[list][*]Some duping bugs have been exterminated
[*]Additional improvements to frame rate, specifically targeting the area around bear spawns
[*]Tree synchronization should be more stable when joining games
[*]Wolves no longer turn away from Player while attacking
[*]Creatures can no longer be pushed around 
[*]General stability and networking tweaks[/list]



[h1]ADDED:[/h1]
[b][u]General:[/u][/b]
[list][*]New audio added when player intereacts with campfires
[*]Players now shiver when cold is below 15%[/list]

New options have been added to Settings:
[list][*]Water
[*]Shader Quality
[*]Mouse Smoothing[/list]



[b][u]Crafting:[/u][/b]
Additional recipe changes for higher tier armor and weapon by Game Update #4

Bandages:
[list][*]Bandages now give 15% health
[*]Frost Fern bandages now give 35% health[/list]

Buildings:
[*]Building diagrams can now be disassembled by the player by hitting it
[*]Building diagrams will now decompose overtime if components are not applied
[*]Building diagram rendering distance has been reduced to 25 meters for performance
[list][*]Blacksmithing structures building  plan added (includes forge)
[*]Leanto now produces some heat
[*]Leanto build requirements have been reduced[/list]
[*]Pike of Resurrection now plays ambient audio when active[/list]

Materials:
[list][*]Larger rocks will now produce more components and require less hits to produce an object
[*]Radiant Gems have been added to more larger rocks
[*]Radiant gems now emit a light source
[*]Coal has been added to the rock tables[/list]


[b][u]Food:[/u][/b]
[list][*]Consumable system has been revamped
[list][*]Meat now provides large amounts of hunger satiation 
[*]Berries, nuts, and bandages now provide health boosts in addition to other beneficial effects
[*]Cured meat stack count increased from 3 to 5[/list]
[*]Decayed flesh: Decayed flesh is like playing Russian roulette
[list][*]Decayed flesh now has a chance to restore 25% health
[*]Decayed Flesh now has a chance to consume 20% hunger[/list][/list]



[url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/307880/discussions/3/618456760261884138/]POST BUGS HERE![/url]

notes.title: Savage Lands is AVAILABLE on Steam Early Access!
notes.content:
[h1]Signal Studios and DigitalDNA Games are thrilled to release Savage Lands on Steam Early Access today![/h1] 

Savage Lands is a first person open world survival game that thrusts players deep into an extensive fantasy world filled with vicious creatures and scarce resources to scavenge for shelter and craft a wide array of unique armor and weapons.


Savage Lands is available right now on Steam Early Access for a special launch week price of $14.99 - 40% off the regular Early Access price of $24.99! 
[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/307880]Grab it now![/url] 


[B]Savage Lands features at launch include:[/B]
[list][*][B]Huge Open World:[/B] Fight for survival across an immense, realistic open world that contains changing time of day, evolving weather conditions, diverse creatures and other surprises scattered around.
[*][B]Build Your World:[/B] Erect shelters for you and your allies to escape hostile creatures and players that roam the island.
[*][B]Robust Item Crafting:[/B] Craft over 50+ unique recipes for armor, weapons, tools and more from the materials scavenged from the land.
[*][B]Multiplayer:[/B] Fight alone or team up with up to 7 other players co-cooperatively to gain resources; open your world to the public or host password protected private games with your friends.

- Robust Item Crafting: Craft over 50+ unique recipes for armor, weapons, tools and more from the materials scavenged from the land.
- Multiplayer: Fight alone or team up with up to 7 other players co-cooperatively to gain resources; open your world to the public or host password protected private games with your friends.

notes.content:
[h1]FIXED[/h1]
[list][*]General crash and stability improvements
[*]Bears are no longer snooty; they will now attack Players
[*]Fire Pits now burn out. They will not restart when a save game is loaded[/list]

[list][*]4th Player spawn location added

[b][u]ART[/u][/b]

[*]Rock outcroppings added to water[/list]


[b][u]CREATURES[/u][/b]

[b][u]PLAYER[/u][/b]

Thank you <3

~ Your friendly neighbourhood development team[/i]

[list][*]Housing loot spawners have been rebalanced

notes.title: Alpha Patch #4 Version 0.1.4, Build 16141
notes.content:
[h1]FIXED:[/h1]
[b]Lots of bug fixes (thanks to the community for finding and reporting these!)[/b]

[list]
[*]Hay Stacks are no longer inside out
[*]Cutting down trees with a worn metal axe will no longer cause them to duplicate
[*]Deer and Skellies should no longer clip through stone formations, crags and buildings
[*]Resolved the Duplication Glitch (Save Games)
[*]Enemies can no longer climb on top of the buildings in the village.
[*]Placing a fire on top of another fire no longer crashes game
[*]Players can punch down trees
[*]Skeletons should no longer clip or walk through buildings when they’re attacking the player.
[*]Trees should give up multiple logs again
[*]Wolves can no longer run up trees
[*]Fixed trees should no longer intersect with structures
[*]Fixes to terrain texture size settings in metadata​[/list]



[h1]ADDED[/h1]
[b][u]General[/u][/b]
[list][*]Stability improvements and crash fixes
[*][b]Players no longer need to be friends to see other servers in the list[/b][/list]

[b][u]Art & Visual FX[/u][/b]
[*]Enhanced Fire & blood particle system
[*]Campfire & Torch visual overhaul
[*]Blood impacts improved, they now incorporate the new lit shader that uses normal & spec[/list]


[b][u]Audio[/u][/b]
[list][*]​Reverb fx added that change the sound for indoor/outdoor areas[/list]

[b][u]Creatures[/u][/b]
[list][*]​Creature health tuned (larger creatures have become more powerful)[/list]

[b][u]Player[/u][/b]
[list][*]Fire Pits regen cold meter 20% quicker
[*]Hunger now decays 25% less when idle/walking
[*]Weapon Damage tuned
[*]Durability increased for all weapons that can chop trees and mine
[*]Bleed is now set to a duration
[*]Journal now provides a basic survival checklist containing the tasks the player should [*]preform to get a feel for the game
[*]Inventory window now reflects the correct player stats[/list]


[b][u]Inventory[/u][/b]
[list][*]​15 slot Pine Strong Box (storage chest) can now be crafted and placed inside your house​
[*]Bandages should now bind bleeding wounds (quantity needed may vary based on strength of the attacker)
[*]Bandages max stack increased to 25
[*]Frost Fern Bandage bleed cure amount increased by 60%
[*]Frost Fern Bandages now give the player 10% health
[*]Frost Fern bandage max Stack increased 25
[*]Sinew max Stack Count Increased from 3 to 10
[*]Strong Sinew max stack count increased from 3 to 10
[*]Cloth Shred stack increased from 10 to 15
[*]Large/Small rock mining tables tuned​
[*]Rocks when mined should now produce stone more often
[*]Rocks when mined now have a chance to spawn amber[/list]


[b][u]Environment[/u][/b]
[list][*]Added specular maps to terrain ground textures[/list]


[url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/307880/discussions/3/]Please post any bugs in the Bug Report forum![/url]

notes.title: Alpha Patch Notes #2 - Version 0.1.2 Build 15945
notes.content:
New version is live! Please post all feedback on the new build [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/307880/discussions/3/618453594745827452/]HERE!![/url]


[b]General Updates:[/b] 
[list][*]Players can now create multiple characters
[*]Players can now save/load worlds in solo and multiplayer
[*]General stability fixes (lots of crash bugs stomped)[*]Players no longer crash when joining hosted game
[*]If a player has any menu open, their character no longer slowly begins to shake until they are shaking rapidly
[*] Weapons are correctly spawn into the game.
[*]Cooked Deer meat no longer floats in mid-air when player drops it onto the ground
[*]Password protecting a server no longer blocks all players with correct password from joining
[*]All trees can now be chopped down
[*]Cutting down a tree no longer causes it to duplicate
[*]If the player dies when the Cold Meter is completely drained, the meter no longer remains empty on respawn
[*]Frost Fern Bandage now correctly cures bleeding immediately on use 
[*]Day and Night system now correctly syncs always in sync between host and clients.[/list]


[b]Art Updates[/b]
[list][*]New terrain textures & normal maps
[*]New texture distribution by altitude range, gets snowier as you are higher
[*]New steepness splat map layer & cliff textures
[*]Corrected global normal map, fixes many terrain lighting issues
[*]Varieties of grass species doubled from 8 to 16
[*]Grass splat map reworked, and is now accommodating all objects placed on map
[*]Daytime direct & ambient light boosted
[*]Rocks lod 1 switch range pushed farther back
[*]Many small fixes & enhancements to the terrain & vegetation
[*]Pass on base texturing underneath villages (more to come) 
[*]Some coarse pathing in/out of village edges (also first pass)
[*]Majority of grasses removed from village sites
[*]Overall tree/bush density increased by 25%
[*]Fixed trees intersecting with rocks 
[*]Boosted snow texture brightness
[*]Fixes to terrain texture normal maps
[*]New textures added to stone houses[/list]


[b]Food Updates:[/b]
[list][*]Hunger consumption while sprinting reduced by 30%
[*]Cooked Bear Meat: [i]Grants 40% Stamina, 30% Health, 30% Heat when consumed[/i]
[*]Cooked Boar Meat: [i]Grants 14% Stamina, 12% Health, 12% Heat when consumed[/i]
[*]Cooked Deer Meat: [i]Grants 18% Stamina, 15% Health, 15% Heat when consumed[/i]
[*]Cooked Goat Meat: [i]Grants 10% Stamina, 10% Health, 10% Heat when consumed[/i]
[*]Cooked Wolf Meat: [i]Grants 15% Stamina, 15% Health, 18% Heat when consumed[/i][/list]


[b]Inventory Updates:[/b]
[list][*]Small pouch Increased lots to 4
[*]Player now starts with a Tattered Sack
[*]Starting items temporarily spawn in player’s inventory (new characters only)
[*]Starting locations items revamped
[*]Drop tables revamped for items that spawn in villages
[*]Leather armor removed from world drop tables and replaced with worn leather armor
[*]Nightbloom Flowers spawners added to the world (localized to just two locations)
[*]New stone texture added to stone houses
[*]Charred skeletons now spawn in the village of Vek
[*]Monolith hides many secrets[/list]
